policy: External media is linked or streamed only from the documented source; copyrighted lectures are not bundled without permission.

text.note: Quran text must remain unchanged and attribution must be preserved.

primaryCatalog.note: Use source pages and their published permissions/terms; do not mirror copyrighted audio into the app without permission.

sourcePrinciples: Every Quran text record must have a traceable source.
Every hadith and dhikr record must retain source/reference metadata.
Do not invent verses, hadith text, scholar quotes, or lecture metadata.
For third-party audio, prefer streaming/linking unless redistribution rights are explicit.
Keep a visible source and attribution screen in the application.
